resolved_findings.issue: Relative-MSE and timing aggregation order was ambiguous
resolved_findings.resolution: Roadmap section3 defines source/expert MSE averaged over prescribed layers and seeds before ratio; expert effects and sources/strata are equally weighted. Tiny denominators are recorded and can make the main relative criterion INCONCLUSIVE. Timing uses median of three within condition, then seed-paired log ratio, source averaging and stratified aggregation. Linear comparator is chosen by CAL-CV; DEV intervals are explicitly screening evidence.

Static12 are diagnostic and not proof that rare false motion has been excluded. Exact slot validation belongs to the other cohort reviewer.

execution_conditions_not_satisfied_by_th: Real image/prompt identities, licensing/availability, near-duplicate clusters and exposure audit must be bound before a runner consumes any slot.
Concrete finite RUN_SPEC, producer/model/code/input/metric hashes, capacities and resource limits require the repository prescribed preexecution review and ACTIVE binding.
Numerical producer parity, fixed-panel coordinates, solver certificates and all80 deployment must be verified in their actual scopes.
All seven final implementations and fair backgrounds must exist; missing nearest-neighbor arms leave their claims unanswered.
No power guarantee is made for every semantic subgroup, rare failure mode or all joint guards; actual effective n and precision may yield INCONCLUSIVE.
Any subsequent change to the reviewed file bytes requires a new targeted review or an explicit record of its limited scope.
